newsitem.title: USA: Conductus to close plant, sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Conductus to close plant, sell unit.

text.p: Conductus Inc said Tuesday it is closing its Instrument and Systems division in San Diego and selling product rights and associated assets at its NMR spectroscopy probe business, to Bruker Instruments.

As a result of this consolidation, Conductus said it will discontinue several of its laboratory instrumentation and custom system product lines made at its San Diego facility. It said it will seek buyers of those product lines and transfer the remaining product lines that are not being discontinued to its main facility in Sunnyvale.
The company said staffing at the Instrument and Systems Division has been reduced to a small group charged with completing works in process and facilitating the transfer of products.
The company said its core technology is superconducting magnetic sensors, and that the laboratory instrumentation and custom systems businesses have not shown significant growth opportunities.
